links.outcome: Whether model ranking of RAG-enabled LLM treatment plans depends on evaluation metric
links.effect: Model ordering differed by metric: Qwen highest LLM-judge (0.809), Doubao highest embedding similarity (0.8489), Claude highest ROUGE-1 recall (0.2729); no configuration uniformly best.
links.quote: Model ordering differed by automated metric: Qwen had the highest mean LLM-judge score (0.809; DeepSeek-R1, 0.807), Doubao had the highest mean embedding similarity (0.8489), and Claude had the highest mean ROUGE-1 recall (0.2729).

unlisted_practices: Controlled ablation of retrieval-augmented generation to isolate its contribution
Use of multiple automated metrics alongside blinded physician rating to evaluate LLM treatment plans

screen.reason: Retrospective benchmark/reader evaluation comparing 4 RAG-enabled LLM configurations against clinician plans across different automated and clinician evaluation metrics, without an ablation or comparative test of a specific organizational deployment practice.
